# rustinion_device_agent_update (Resource)

One device's own Rustinion agent self-update setting, overriding its group's agent-update policy for that device only: "follow_group", "auto" (always install new releases), "paused" (no new agent release is offered, including by Force update) or "pinned" (updated up to pinned_version and kept there; never downgraded). The machine owner's local --no-self-update still wins. Destroying this resource sets the device back to follow_group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) The device.

### Optional

- `mode` (String) "follow_group", "auto", "paused" or "pinned". Default follow_group.
- `pinned_version` (String) A published agent version such as "0.1.230". Required when mode is pinned, not allowed otherwise.
- `reason` (String) Why this device differs from its group (shown on the device and group pages and in the audit log). Only for auto, paused or pinned; at most 500 characters.

### Read-Only

- `explanation` (String) The effective setting in words, as the device page shows it.
- `id` (String) Same as device_id.
- `source` (String) device_setting or group_policy.
